comments.body: Hi @kokun66, thanks for raising that issue. I opened a PR for `flashdreams` with the missing file but this is not the end of the story - there's also a minor adjustment needed on Alpasim side and, more importantly, our latest dataset release is missing some files needed by the video model. I'll update this ticket when the pipeline works.
